hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in */frontend/*.ts|*/frontend/*.tsx|*/frontend/*.js|*/frontend/*.jsx) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; cd "${f%%/frontend/*}/frontend" || exit 0; out=$(npx --no-install tsc -b 2>&1 && npm run --silent lint 2>&1); [ $? -eq 0 ] || { printf '%s\n' "$out" >&2; exit 2; }
